topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 356 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 48 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs, 7 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 45 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, erc20permit, eip712). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
